name: Derro
sourceDistinctions: Underdark gives the playable Derro 3d8 racial Hit Dice, LA +1, and ECL 4, and describes adventurers with Madness. This profile retains that trait.
The core Monster Manual profile lists LA +2 if sane and no level adjustment for its default monster. These are different advancement entries.
Use the core monster ability conversion on the printed scores after removing the printed Madness adjustments. Add the trait’s −6 Wisdom and +6 Charisma once for this profile.
Both builds use Common and buy Undercommon with two racial skill points. The original Derro entry gives no racial language list.
The Monster Manual errata discuss Diirinka but give no correction to the Derro ability or advancement entries.
portraitForm: Dorr Palevein, an original Derro tunnel guide
